Game Overview

In Christmas Memichan, the core idea is straightforward: embrace the holiday spirit with Christmas Memichan, a delightful 2D adventure where you guide Santa Cat Memichan through wintery landscapes. Master double jumps and navigate devious enemies to gather chocolate bars. With each level, face thrilling challenges before dashing back to Memichan's cozy home. Can you conquer the Christmas quest?
